description: This file defines the functionality for creating a new article, including data validation, command handling, and database operations within a CQRS pattern for an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article creation, including title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validation class for ArticleData to ensure required fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating article data, used in the MediatR pipeline.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation for the Command to ensure the article data is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new article, including author retrieval, tag processing, saving to database, and returning the article envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method to process the creation command, save the article, associate tags, and return the result.
